    title = "Vibe coding needs a spec, too"

    search_input = comp.get_by_role("searchbox", name="Search")

        search_input = comp.get_by_role("textbox")
        if await search_input.count() == 0:
            print({"error": "no_search_input_found_in_complementary"})

    # Fill the query
    await search_input.fill(title)

    # Click the Search button inside the complementary region
    search_button = comp.get_by_role("button", name="Search")
    if await search_button.count() == 0:
        # Fallback: click the first button inside complementary
        search_button = comp.get_by_role("button").nth(0)
        if await search_button.count() == 0:
            # As a last resort press Enter in the search field
            await search_input.press("Enter")
    else:
        await search_button.click()

    # Wait for search results to appear in the main region (or for network to quiet)
    try:

    link_locator = page.get_by_role("main").get_by_role("link", name=title)

    # Extract href if available (prefer to navigate via the href so we use a relative goto when possible)
    href = None

    if href:

        await link_locator.nth(0).click()
        resolved_for_report = page.url  # best-effort; will be replaced after navigation

    # After navigation, wait for main/article content to appear
    try:
